subject: [hw] IP -> P04: frame timeout 1 s races the daemon 2 s encode bound
body:
Patch 1s 1000 ms frame/1 s timeout is shorter than vcodecd 1s default hardware encode bound (OPEN uses --hw-timeout-ms 2000; one send can wait 2x half = ~2 s, and a slow success is accepted). A 1080p first frame that takes 1.2 s would make P04 declare the session fatal while the daemon is still encoding; the reply then goes to a closed session.

Please use N2HWENC_FRAME_TIMEOUT_MS 3000 (or 2500) instead of 1000. Connect+OPEN 2000 is fine: our OPEN AP timeout is 2 s and OPEN can take a few sends; 2 s may still be tight for a cold vpud init, but clients normally open after boot. If you want a hard 1 s, tell me and I will lower the daemon default, but that risks on-phone first-frame timeouts.

No daemon change needed for dts=pts: OPEN is IPPP (num_b_frame=0).
